exams.title: विधि अधिकारी (Law Officer) 2026 · जेल विभाग

relax.who: MP domicile SC / ST / OBC, PwD, MP govt / corporation / board employees, Nagar Sainik, women (UR and reserved)

relax.rule: deduct defence service; result must not exceed the max by more than 3 years

relax.who: Inter-caste marriage awardee couple's savarna partner; Vikram award sportspersons

age.relaxNote: Reservation and age relaxation only for MP domicile; others are treated as Unreserved. Overall cap 45 years for every category.

fee.note: Reserved = MP domicile SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwD. Portal charges extra. Pay by card, net banking or MPOnline kiosk; no DD/cheque.

all: विधि में स्नातक उपाधि (Bachelor's degree in Law)
अधिवक्ता के रूप में 2 वर्ष का अनुभव (परिशिष्ट-5 प्रमाण-पत्र और शपथ-पत्र)
allEn: 2 years' practice as an Advocate (Appendix-5 certificate and affidavit)

exams.employmentRegistration: Not needed to apply; MP residents must show a live employment-office registration before interview (govt / private employees exempt with NOC / service certificate). Other-state candidates exempt.
disqualify: Convicted of an offence against women
More than two living children with one born on/after 26.01.2001
exams.photo: Recent colour passport photo, light or white background, no selfie, no cap or dark glasses, face fully visible.
exams.selection: OMR exam with negative marking, then interview (up to 3x posts). If fewer than 500 candidates: interview only.
exams.payment: Credit/debit card, net banking, or cash at an MPOnline kiosk. No DD/cheque.
